item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena wants to light a small torch bulb using one dry cell. She tries four different arrangements of connecting wires between the cell and the bulb.
In which arrangement will the bulb glow?

options.A: One wire joins the positive terminal of the cell to one side of the bulb, and the other side of the bulb is left unconnected.
options.B: One wire joins the positive terminal of the cell to one side of the bulb, and a second wire joins the other side of the bulb to the negative terminal of the cell.
options.C: One wire joins both terminals of the cell together, and the bulb is held near the cell without touching it.
options.D: Two wires join the positive terminal of the cell to both sides of the bulb, and the negative terminal is left unconnected.
